**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stage 10.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv playbook --triage <section>` is on disk (`tools/nv/cmd/playbook.ts:707`). Sections `divergences`, `splitting-a-file`, `running-things` and `writing-a-test-case` are decided: the report for each says every bullet names a file and declares a condition the tree decides. `writing-novis` and `tooling` (301 of 397) still owe.

A bullet has two homes that are read: the fragment under `docs/agent/playbook/<section>/` and the record under `data/playbook/<section>/`. A batch changes both. `.agent-tmp/triage-splitting.ts <batch.json>` is the batch script. Its batch file is `{ "section", "delete": [ids], "keep": { id: "path:word" } }`, and `.agent-tmp/triage-test-12.json` is the latest example. The script checks that each `gone` condition stands before it writes anything, and refuses the whole batch if one does not. It also deletes a bullet an earlier batch kept, which is how a later, clearer duplicate replaces it. A `gone` word must not contain `]`, because the trailer parser stops at the first one. The report's `propose` word is often a poor anchor: check it with `git grep -c -F`. A diagnostic's code (`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:E0459`) is a good anchor for a language claim.

The report's `OWES A DECISION` flag is on the `==` header line. `awk '/^== /{p = /OWES A DECISION/} p'` pulls only the owed blocks, `awk '/^== /{n++} n<=40'` over that takes one batch, and `grep -v '^  means\|^  file'` drops the noise lines. Forty blocks per batch fit a session four times.

A language claim is cheap to probe: a short `.nvs` under `.agent-tmp/p/` run with `target/debug/nvs.exe check` or `run`. Probes this session found these compile now: two `catch` clauses in one scope with the same variable, a bare array literal passed to a plain `array<T>` `Core` parameter (`Core\Arr::diff`, `replaceRange`), `Core\Arr::contains($floats, 1)`, and a read of the narrowed variable inside `while ($x != null)`. These are still refused: an array literal as a `foreach` subject, into a union parameter or into a generic `T` (`Core\Cli::select`), `int` into a `uint` parameter, `uint / uint` into `uint`, `$x->` re-assigned from itself inside a narrowed loop (`E0459`), `await 5`, `var T $x`, `throw new Exception`, `Core\Str::from`, and an interface method with no `public` (`E0122`).

The goal-only sweep is red on the four checks later stages own: Stage 9's `audit checks`, Stage 11's `audit ci` and `loop-stats --guard`, and Stage 12's `audit python`, plus Stage 10's trailer check until every section is triaged.
